nodes.prompt: A man visits your village claiming to offer a government scheme: 'Pay ₹2,000 registration fee and get ₹50,000 subsidy in 1 week!' He shows an official-looking certificate. What do you do?

options.label: Ask him to show official government website link
Call local bank or gram panchayat to verify first

nodes.prompt: He disappeared with your ₹2,000. The 'scheme' was completely fake. You were scammed.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Fraud Detection] No legitimate government scheme ever asks for ADVANCE payment. Real schemes have a documented application process on official .gov.in websites.

nodes.prompt: He couldn't provide a valid .gov.in URL and left quickly! You saved ₹2,000 from a classic scam.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Fraud Detection] Always verify schemes at pmkisan.gov.in, agricoop.nic.in, or your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra. If there's no official website, it's a fraud.

nodes.prompt: The panchayat confirmed it was a scam operating in 3 nearby villages. You alerted your community!
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Fraud Detection] Community verification is the strongest shield against fraud. Report suspicious persons to the National Cyber Crime Helpline: 1930.
